title: Unit – 5 : Session – 1 : SLO – 2  |  Challenges in Parallel Systems
sections: 1. b) Memory consistency — when multiple processors access shared data, agreeing on the order/visibility of writes is a major challenge.
2. b) Communication overhead — the time spent dividing tasks, exchanging data and merging results.
3. b) Load balancing — when work is unevenly distributed some processors sit idle, wasting capacity.
